# Data Source: identitynow_source

Use this data source to access information about an existing Source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_source" "example" {
  name = "Active Directory"
}

output "identitynow_source_description" {
  value = data.identitynow_source.example.description
}

output "identitynow_source_owner_name" {
  value = data.identitynow_source.example.owner[0].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the source.

### Read-Only

- `authoritative` (Boolean) Whether the source is authoritative.
- `cluster` (Attributes List) List with the virtual appliance cluster of the source, empty when the source has no cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster))
- `connector` (String) Connector script name, e.g. `active-directory`.
- `delete_threshold` (Number) Maximum percentage of accounts that can be deleted during an aggregation.
- `description` (String) Source description.
- `id` (String) Source ID.
- `owner` (Attributes List) List with the owner of the source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))

<a id="nestedatt--cluster"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `name` (String) Cluster name.
- `type` (String) Cluster type, `CLUSTER`.


<a id="nestedatt--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Owner identity ID.
- `name` (String) Owner name.
- `type` (String) Owner type, `IDENTITY`.
